mapper.select: select c.id, c.content, c.user_id, c.target_id, c.type, c.nick_name, c.create_time, case when c.type = 1 then h.title when c.type = 2 then n.title end as target_name from ich_comment c left join heritage h on c.type = 1 and c.target_id = h.heritage_id left join news n on c.type = 2 and c.target_id = n.news_id where c.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into ich_comment (content, user_id, target_id, type, nick_name, create_time) values (#{content}, #{userId}, #{targetId}, #{type}, #{nickName}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from ich_comment where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
